# Home Internet Cafe

> Local digital services company serving individuals and small businesses in Temba and surrounding areas: printing, CV typing, online applications, computer support, web design, and website maintenance.

Home Internet Cafe is based at 950 Hans Kekana View, South Africa. Contact via WhatsApp on 084 592 4683 or email homeinternetcafe950@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/): Overview of all services and pricing highlights.
- [Services & Pricing](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/services): Full price list for Tech & Software, Printing & Copies, CV & Admin Typing, and Digital & Web Services.
- [Applications & CV](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/applications): CV typing and online application services for job seekers in Temba.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/maintenance): Monthly website care and support plans.
- [About](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/about): Business background and service values.
- [Contact](https://homeinternetcafe.co.za/contact): Contact details and quote request form.

## Notes

All prices are in South African Rand (ZAR) and are current as displayed on the live site. For the latest pricing, refer to the Services & Pricing and Website Maintenance & Support pages directly rather than cached summaries.
